content_units: Best Dinner Pick for Namba on 2026-11-14

For your group of 5,   Green Lantern Bistro   is the most suitable choice overall. It fits the walk-time and budget, works for   two vegetarians  , can accommodate   one guest avoiding shellfish  , and keeps a   casual   feel better than the stricter trade-offs in the other options.
Venue Comparison for Your Group
Venue   Walk from Namba Station   Avg Price   Vegetarian Fit   Shellfish-Avoiding Fit   Atmosphere   Verdict
Green Lantern Bistro   8 min   JPY 3,900   Strong vegetarian-friendly menu   Good; shellfish dishes are optional   Casual, lively     Best overall fit
Crab Alley   6 min   JPY 4,200   Weak; limited vegetarian options   Poor; seafood-heavy   Casual   Not suitable
Hearth & Rice   11 min   JPY 4,600   Very good; set meals available   Very good; no shellfish in core menu   Quieter, less casual-buzzy   Strong backup, but over budget target
Skewer House South   10 min   JPY 3,500   Poor; only one vegetarian item   Unclear to limited   Casual, smoky   Not suitable
Why Green Lantern Bistro Wins
Option 1:   Green Lantern Bistro     Best balance of dietary flexibility, budget, and distance     Reservations accepted
- Two vegetarians should have enough choice without forcing side-dish ordering.
- The shellfish-avoiding guest can order safely from non-shellfish items since shellfish is optional rather than central.
-   JPY 3,900 average   stays under your   JPY 4,500 per person   cap.
-   8-minute walk   is comfortably inside your 12-minute limit.
- “Usually busy” is manageable because they   accept reservations  , which matters for   5 people at 19:00  .
Reserve nearby
Option 2:   Hearth & Rice     Best dietary safety backup, but weaker on price/casual match     Quiet seating
- Excellent for vegetarians and the shellfish-avoiding diner.
- The main drawback is   JPY 4,600 average  , which is slightly above your budget cap.
- It also sounds more calm than casually social, so it is a better fallback than first choice.
Check route
Booking Notes for 19:00
-   Reserve Green Lantern Bistro   for 5 people as early as possible since it is usually busy.
- Ask for:
-   2 vegetarian-friendly orders
-   1 no-shellfish order
- seating in a   non-crowded casual section   if available
- If Green Lantern is full, choose   Hearth & Rice   as the safest fallback for dietary needs.

Selection Basis

Using your stated priorities in order:   dietary fit first  , then   budget  , then   casual atmosphere  , then   walking distance  . On that basis,   Green Lantern Bistro   is the best match;   Hearth & Rice   is the backup if you want a quieter, more diet-safe dinner and can stretch the budget slightly.
